query.description: Search query or keyword phrase. Use the user's natural-language topic.

responseFormat.description: Response shape. Use v2 for agent-friendly {success,data,meta,error}; legacy remains available for older clients.

slug.description: Exact public slug for a blog post, guide, location page, comparison, glossary term, CMS page, or landing page.

tools.name: search_blog_knowledge

count.description: Number of returned records for list and search tools.

data.description: Structured result payload. Present for responseFormat='v2' tools.

error.description: Human-readable error message when success is false.

meta.description: Result metadata such as count, locale fallback, cache scope, or response format.

success.description: Whether the tool call completed successfully.
